eyebrow: Azure Hybrid Benefit, applied to the VM
code:
Apply an owned SQL Server license (w/ Software Assurance)
to the VM image -> pay Azure for infrastructure only,
not a license you already own
caption: Often the single biggest cost lever in a real licensed-server migration.
